7.6 Operation cycle management
The Dem module provides the possibility to define different operation cycles (ref. to
ISO-14229-1[2]).
Examples of operation cycles are:
• ignition on/off cycle
• power up/power down cycle
• OBD driving cycle
• engine warm up cycle
• operation active/passive cycle
• accumulated operating time
The various operation cycles serve as the basis for calculating cycle-dependent
status information such as testCompleteThisOperationCycle. In addition, the oper-
ation cycles are the basis for certain functionalities such as the confirmation of
failures and the aging of failures. The restart or switch to the next operation cycle
via Dem_RestartOperationCycle serves as the trigger for the calculation of these
functionalities.
